actionable_steps.citation: Compassionate Heart is the Temple of God — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-04-27
actionable_steps.step: Speak amiably today even when others speak to you harshly — that is compassion in action.

actionable_steps.citation: Hospitals Are Meant To Serve The Poor And Needy — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-01-19
actionable_steps.step: Do one concrete act of service for the poor or needy — do not be stonehearted or money-minded.
Turn your love into concrete acts — compassion must become service, not remain a feeling.
Share both tears and cheers with others; engage in service until your heart softens.

actionable_steps.citation: Ceiling on desires - II — SSS Vol 17 (1984), 1984-07-14
actionable_steps.step: Let your kindness come from the heart, not from show — true compassion has no trace of vanity.

definition.quote: Compassion means reflecting in our minds the joys and sorrows of others, and responding with exhilaration and sympathy.

discourses.citation: Compassionate Heart is the Temple of God — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-04-27
discourses.quote: The heart filled with compassion is divine. Even if others talk to us harshly, we should always speak amiably. One can find fulfillment in life only with compassion and mercy.

discourses.citation: Let everyone do his duty — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-03-20
discourses.quote: Compassion is the hallmark of Bhakthi (devotion). No one can hope to please God without showing dhaya (compassion) towards his fellow-men. A loving heart is the temple of God.

discourses.citation: Role of the Avathaar in the cosmic play — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-09-19
discourses.quote: The heart with dhaya (compassion) is Dhaivam (God). If one has no dhaya his nature is devilish. Compassion is the most essential quality of a human being. Without compassion, man is inhuman.

discourses.citation: Manifest the Divine within you — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-07-20
discourses.quote: Dhaya sakha (Compassion is friend). There is no greater quality than compassion. It is compassion, which redeems human life.

make_it_real: Your heart is called hridaya because it holds compassion — let it live up to its name today.
title: Compassion

vahinis.quote: Rama's heart was filled with compassion; he gave refuge to anyone who took shelter in him and surrendered to him... His compassion and softness of heart are beyond description; no words can convey their depth and extent.
